source.prompt: One complete compact medieval stone bastion citadel model, coherent connected architecture around one square inner courtyard. Dominant tall rectangular central keep at the rear with steep dark desaturated blue slate hip roof and blue banner bearing restrained gold heraldic motif. Three to four secondary square crenellated defensive towers, asymmetric height and roof treatment, continuous pale warm limestone curtain walls, prominent vaulted timber gate below front wall, parapet battlements, masonry stairways and simple timber balcony galleries along the courtyard. A few small attached slate-roofed support halls; believable stone arches, recesses, worn joints and old timber. The fortress is recovered from ruin but not a royal palace; compact early-midgame level five with clear room for later upgrades. Grounded semi-realistic medieval fantasy, readable at isometric mobile game distance, weathered limestone, oak and blue slate PBR, isolated on plain neutral background.
